historical.source_numeric_type: cached Excel value, rendered as Python float shortest round-trip decimal
historical.extraction_method: Direct cached-value extraction; the workbook XML value is parsed as Decimal and rendered with Python float shortest round-trip representation. K formulas are validated, including shared-formula masters. No formula re-evaluation or financial reconstruction.

notes: Historical segment is the workbook's spliced FFR/3M-yield series. The post-2021 extension is FRED FEDFUNDS and is not part of the original workbook.
limitations: FRED extension acquisition metadata (download date, request URL/query, retrieval tool) is not recorded in the repository.
The workbook does not document the upstream source or vintage of column N.

extension.source_revision_status: FRED series is subject to revision; this artifact uses a frozen local snapshot pinned by SHA-256
